title: WELCOME DISASTER TOUR
description: New players now start with a guided airship flyover of the farm valley, extraction gate, raid volcano, kart track, and suspiciously monetized pet district before choosing a first objective.
consequence: The opening finally admits what game this is. The first hour gets a map instead of a blindfold.

title: ONE PRICE FRONTIER
description: The game now opens as a single paid frontier pass with no referral quests, install bonuses, creator codes, friend-invite popups, or limited-time newcomer bundles.
consequence: The first hour gets cleaner. The growth plan loses every trick at the door.

title: CREATOR DROP STORM
description: Early missions now shower players with limited creator-branded weapons, animated loot beams, referral crates, and a rotating "everyone is using this" loadout banner.
consequence: The arsenal becomes an ad break. The growth chart gets confetti cannons.

title: LICENSE EXAM PROLOGUE
description: New drivers must now complete a written rules test, parallel parking trial, tire pressure checklist, and three supervised laps before entering the open-world racing festival.
consequence: The starting line gets a clipboard. The festival gate gets quieter.
